frames.prompt: Cartoon game VFX bullet-hits-wall impact, top-down overhead view, isolated on transparent background, centered. STYLE: vibrant warm cartoon FX, Brawl Stars quality. Punchy, immediate, full-energy impact. Wide readable shape at small size. Warm palette: white-yellow-orange. NO background, NO text.
